responsibility: Provides the general GCC OS configuration shared by NetBSD targets. It defines common NetBSD preprocessor builtins and assertions, CPP/LIB/LIBGCC specs, optional native-tree include and tool paths, shared-library init/fini collector helpers, libc capability defaults, standard wchar/wint type definitions, POSIX I/O support, and the SUBTARGET_INIT_BUILTINS hook that invokes NetBSD builtin patching. This is the base NetBSD configuration header, while netbsd-elf.h adds ELF-specific start/endfile and link specs.
same_name_distinction: This is the base configuration header in the netbsd group, defining common NetBSD builtins, specs, types, and the hook that calls netbsd_patch_builtins; unlike gcc/config/netbsd.cc it does not implement the patching logic itself, and unlike gcc/config/netbsd.opt it is not an option table.
